title: Count equal pairs
prompt: Implement `countPairs(int[] a)`: count index pairs `i < j` where `a[i] == a[j]`. The double loop over i then j (starting at i + 1) is the honest O(n squared) approach — fine here.

tests.name: duplicates
tests.hint: inner loop starts at i + 1, not 0 — otherwise pairs count twice.
